title: Heavenly Completion in a month
summary: Mu Chen turns down Ling Xi's transfer of power, not wanting to use others as stepping stones, and a vision of his mother Qing Yanjing appears to him. Elsewhere Xiao Xiao reads Luo Li's letter about the cold young elder who favours Mu Chen and even gave him a Level 5 Spiritual Formation, then uncovers Blood race spies inside the Luo race and sets off to check on Luo Li. Ling Xi offers a harsher way: pry open a corner of the academy's Level 8 Spirit Collecting Formation, built by Lord Beiming, for a spiritual energy cleansing that only his Thunder Body could survive. The dean and elders let it run while the students, and a Heavenly Ranking pair who have been shaken since the Penalty Hall rescue, watch. Ling Xi tells Luo Li she was raised by Aunt Jing and is like a sister to Mu Chen. With days to spare Mu Chen breaks through to the initial phase of Heavenly Completion, then beats the dean's test, a Hell-Spirit Puppet at late-phase Heavenly Completion, with the Great Sumeru Demonic Pillar. Tai Cang concedes the bet and agrees to take him to Holy Spirit Mountain, and to open the North Heaven Gate again as the ranked students demand.
events: Mu Chen declines Ling Xi's power transfer; a vision of Qing Yanjing
Xiao Xiao reads Luo Li's letter and deals with Blood race spies in the Luo race

Tai Cang concedes the bet; the students win a promise to reopen the North Heaven Gate
Ling Xi decides to go to Holy Spirit Mountain too
cultivation: Mu Chen breaks through from late-phase Heavenly Transformation to the initial phase of Heavenly Completion (subs: early stage of the Completion of Heaven Level), then beats a Hell-Spirit Puppet at late-phase Heavenly Completion.
